issue.title: `pytest` prevents plugin packages from uninstalling cleanly

labels.name: type: bug
labels.description: problem that needs to be addressed

labels.name: topic: rewrite
labels.description: related to the assertion rewrite mechanism

issue.body:
<!--
Thanks for submitting an issue!

Quick check-list while reporting bugs:
-->

Problem
----
When `pytest` is run, additional `pytest`-versioned `.pyc` files are generated in the plugins' `__pycache__/` directories. Since said `.pyc` files aren't in the egg info, they aren't cleaned up during `pip uninstall` and thus causes the parent directory to persist as a phantom "namespace package".

This has been tested with [`pytest-xdist`](https://github.com/pytest-dev/pytest-xdist) (a `pytest-dev` plugin), [`pytest-doctestplus`](https://github.com/scientific-python/pytest-doctestplus) (a third-party plugin), and also [a plugin I wrote myself](https://gitlab.com/TTsangSC/pytest-autoprofile). The issue is consistent, and thus I am leaning more towards this being a `pytest` problem than a plugin problem.

----

comments.body:
i believe we'd have to deviate from the current mechanism and place the pytest py files into either the user cache dir or the local pytest cache dir

its not clear how to do this well and its not a high priority for us as the need to uninstall from a test env is commonly not given

based on observation (albeit personal) different install sets are tested in different ci envs 
so the handling of uninstall is not actually on the horizon - even more so with uv and other tools making env creation/recreation be much less expensive
Thanks for the quick reply; fair enough. I'll close the issue then.
